correctness.rationale: The fixed-point equation is rearranged reversibly for \(z>0\) to \(\lambda=8z^4/(1+z)^3\). Its logarithmic derivative is \((z+4)/(z(1+z))\), strictly positive on the full positive domain. The source formulas \(\kappa=\gamma=1/(1+z)\) for \(z<1\) and \(\kappa=\gamma=z/(1+z)\) for \(z>1\) make the strict extremality/non-extremality boundaries \(z=\sqrt{3}-1\) and \(z=(\sqrt{3}+1)/2\). Exact substitution in \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt{3})\) gives the two claimed activities. Endpoint equality is explicitly excluded rather than inferred.
